step1_analysis.description: A fully differential operational amplifier, likely used as a residue amplifier (MDAC) in the pipeline stages of the ADC. It features a cascoded structure to achieve high gain and bandwidth necessary for 110 MS/s operation.

paper_reference.title: A Cost-Efficient High-Speed 12-bit Pipeline ADC in 0.18-m Digital CMOS

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the op-amp from the 1.8V supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming the op-amp takes ~5-10% of the total ADC power, I_total ~ 2-5 mA. Power = 1.8V * I_total.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down from the total ADC power reported in the paper, adjusted for a single amplifier stage.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported, but 12-bit accuracy requires >72 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain ~ gm * Rout. With cascoding, Rout ~ gm * ro^2. Gain = (2/0.2) * (2/0.2) ~ 1000 V/V = 60 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical cascoded amplifier intrinsic gain in 130nm technology.

unity_gain_bandwidth.description: Frequency at which the open-loop differential gain drops to 0 dB (1 V/V).

paper_reported.value: 110 MS/s conversion rate implies settling time < 4.5 ns, requiring UGBW > 500 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm / (2 * pi * CL). For gm = 5 mS and CL = 1 pF, UGBW = 5m / (2 * 3.14 * 1p) ~ 800 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Required to meet the fast settling time for a 110 MS/s pipeline ADC.

phase_margin.description: Phase difference from -180 degrees at the unity gain frequency, indicating stability.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the location of the non-dominant pole relative to UGBW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard design target for stable closed-loop step response without excessive ringing.

transient_swing.description: Maximum and minimum differential voltage swing during a transient sine wave input.

sky130_expected.calculation: With 1.8V supply and cascoded outputs, max swing is roughly VDD - 4*Vdsat ~ 1.8 - 0.8 = 1.0V single-ended, or 2.0Vpp differential.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported 2Vpp signal swing capability.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC open-loop gain, unity gain bandwidth, phase margin, and transient output swing of the fully differential op-amp.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Differential Op-Amp Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

XM1 OUTP N1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N6 VB4 N10 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 OUTN N6 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUTN VCMFB2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 VCMFB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N10 VCMFB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N8 INN N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N12 INP N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 OUTP VCMFB2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N6 VB3 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N1 VB4 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N1 N1 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N1 VB3 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N4 INN N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

* Power and Bias Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB4 VB4 0 0.99
VVCMFB2 VCMFB2 0 0.9
VVCMFB1 VCMFB1 0 0.9
VVB3 VB3 0 0.54

* Differential Input Sources (DC + AC + Transient Sine)
VINP INP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0)
VINN INN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -0.1 1MEG 0 0)

* Behavioral source for differential output measurement
B1 OUT_DIFF 0 V='V(OUTP) - V(OUTN)'

* Load Capacitors
CL1 OUTP 0 1p
CL2 OUTN 0 1p

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis for Gain, UGBW, and Phase Margin
ac dec 100 1 10G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(OUT_DIFF))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_ugbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis for Output Swing
tran 1n 5u
meas tran v_max max v(OUT_DIFF)
meas tran v_min min v(OUT_DIFF)

quit
.endc
.end
